name: BBQ RIBS, CHICKEN, & BRATS
directions:
BRINE SOLUTION
                        1 cup salt
                        1 gallon of water
					
                        BBQ SAUCE RECIPE
                        1 gallon BBQ sauce
                        1 cup cider vinegar
                        1 1/2 cup water

Note:  Ribs will require more oven time then chicken.

FOR RIBS:  Pull skin off the backs of ribs.  Make brine solution and submerge ribs in brine for 2-4 hours.  Drain; coat with worcestershire; season liberally with Cajun Spice Seasoning (no salting needed).  Place 1 1/2 cups of water in sheet pan and mix in 3/4 tsp. Hickory Smoke Powder to water.  Insert a sprayed rack into sheet pan.  Arrange ribs, back side down, with smaller ends towards center of rack.  Cover tightly with sprayed foil, make sure to crimp foil around edges of sheet pan.  Cook in 350 degree oven for about 1 hour; meat should pull slightly from bone.  Remove foil then return to oven for 5 minutes to dry ribs.  Remove; brush one side with BBQ sauce; return to oven for 10 minutes.  Repeat on other side.  Time permitting, ribs can get two glazings. 
FOR CHICKEN:  Arrange chicken on sprayed rack as following:  legs and wings together with wings place in center of rack; thighs and breasts together (do not crowd pieces together-space apart evenly to ensure even cooking).  Season liberally with Cajun Spice Seasoning.  Place in 350 degree oven and check after 20 minutes; chicken should temp at 160 degrees.  Brush chicken with sauce; return to oven for 15 minutes. 
FOR BRATS:  Turn on grill.  Cover brats with cold water and bring to boil.  Reduce heat; simmer for 20 minutes.  Finish on grill - 3 minutes on each side.  Slice in half on the hard bias.  (Brats can go in same foil pan with chicken)

Garnish for all 3 meats is small-diced red and yellow bell pepper.

name: BTS BROWNIES
directions:
BROWNIE BASE
   5      pounds        Bavarian Chunk chocolate
   6      pounds        margarine
   9      pounds        granulated sugar
   6      pounds        eggs
  12      ounces        dark corn syrup
     1/2  cup           vanilla extract
   1      tablespoon    baking powder
   2      tablespoons   salt
   6 1/2  pounds        flour
   9      ounces        cocoa powder
   3      pounds        walnuts  coarsely chopped

PULL CREAM CHEESE AND MARGARINE TO ROOM TEMP.  Melt chocolate in double boiler over low heat.  Turn off heat; set aside. 
FOR CREAM CHEESE LAYER:  Using the small mixer and paddle, on speed 1, turn on the mixer and add cream cheese blocks one at a time. Let mix for 8 or 10 minutes and thuroughly scrape the bowl and paddle, then mix on speed 2 for 5 more minutes. On speed 1 add eggs and vanilla; mix thoroughly and scrape again then mix for a couple more minutes.  Add the sugar and mix just until incorporated.   Scrape and finish mixing by hand, overmixing will make the mixture too soft and it will be hard to layer the brownie properly. Set aside. 
FOR BROWNIE BATTER:Start by putting chocolate in a double boiler to melt. Using the large mixer and the paddle, cream margarine, corn syrup,and sugar on #3 speed until very light and fluffy; scrape sides of bowl and paddle during this proccess. Combine eggs and vanilla extract and add to butter mixture in small parts on speed 2, scraping the bowl and paddle between each addition; when all eggs are incorporated beat well on speed 3.  With mixer running on #1 speed, add melted chocolate quickly; beat on #3 speed until no chocolate streaks remain, be sure to scrape bottom of bowl to ensure that chocolate is incorporated and beat for another moment. Sift together the flour, cocoa powder, baking powder, and salt. Set mixer to #1 speed and add flour mixture, mix until flour is incorporated then scrape and mix on #3 speed.  Continue mixing until mixture is fluffy (a few more minutes).  Grease 4 sheet pans with extenders.  Scale 4# 8oz. of  brownie batter into each pan; spread evenly. Next put 3# 8oz. of cream cheese mixture into each pan, lay it down in ribbons so it will be easier to spread evenly across the top of the brownie batter. Add remaining cream cheese mixture to the remaining brownie batter and mix thoroughly, set aside.  Carefully spread cheese mixture over chocolate layer.  Sprinkle approx. 4 cups of walnuts on top of each pan; making sure nuts are evenly distributed. Gently press nuts into cream cheese layer with a metal spatula to facilitate even spreading of top batter layer.   Divide remaining batter ( with cream cheese mixed in) between 4 pans (approx. 4# 8oz. per pan) ; dropping batter into 3 rows like cream cheese.  Carefully spread batter over cream cheese making sure cheese layer is covered.  Bake in a 300°oven for 40 minutes,  Rotate and bake for 40 more minutes.  When done,  press down the sides with a metal spatula so that when the middle cools it will be even with the sides.

name: CARROT CAKE

ingredients.name: lbs carrot Minced in food processor.

directions:
CAKE BATTER  300 degree oven - low fan.
Spray 8 sheet pans with oil, then lay down parchment paper in each pan. Using the edge of a bowl spatula, force any air out from under the parchment; air bubbles will expand while baking and cause deformities in the baked sheet of cake. Next spray the top of the parchment, Set pans aside.
Using a food processor, finely mince the carrots and add to the mixing bowl with a paddle attachment. 
Next put the sugar into the mixer and mix on #1 so they begin to macerate. 
Meanwhile, in a large prep bowl mix all dry ingredients and sift. Set aside.
In a bucket, mix together the wet ingredients, making sure the corn syrup isn't stuck to the bottom.
With the mixer off, add all of the dry ingredients and a quarter of the wet and mix on #1, You want a thick batter here, if you add too much wet ingredient at the beginning, you'll get lumps that won't mix in. be sure to scrape the mixing bowl and mix until smooth.
Once your thick batter is smooth, add the rest of the wet a bit at a time. When it's all mixed in, scrape the bowl and mix until smooth.

weigh 6 lbs. of batter into each sheet pan, any extra batter can be divided evenly into the pans. Using a pie spatula, spread the batter evenly and slap the pan flat on the table a few times to ensure the batter has spread evenly.

Bake at 300 degrees with a low fan for 15 minutes then rotate vertically and horizontally and bake another 10 minutes. watch carefully, bake it just until barely done, as it will dry out very easily.

Chill sheets completely before frosting.

FROSTING
Pull your butter and cream cheese out well ahead to let it soften.
Whip the butter in the small mixer with a paddle on #1, then #2 until its consistency matches that of the cream cheese, this way you don't get lumps.
Next add the cream cheese and combine, scrape the bowl a couple times during the process. Don't whip it too fluffy or the frosting will be too soft.
Next, with the mixer off, sift the powdered sugar add it to the bowl. Mix on #1 and scrape a couple times during the process. When well combined add the lime juice.
Mix on #2 until smooth. remember not too fluffy.

FROST THE CAKE
weigh 3.6 lbs. of frosting onto 4 of the sheets and spread it evenly.
The next part is tricky; flip each unfrosted sheet onto a frosted sheet. line it up quickly, it will give you just a few seconds before the cake falls out of the upper pan and onto the frosting. Once the upper sheet falls onto the frosting, you won't be able to move it, so line it up quickly before it falls!
Leave the parchment on the top sheet until you cut it, it keeps better that way when frozen.

Preheat oven to 275 degrees FOR BASE: Combine powdered sugar, flour, cornstarch, and salt in one bowl and sift. Put butter in mixer with paddle and mix just until soft, not whipped or warm.

LEMON FILLING: Preheat oven to 275 degrees WITH HIGH FAN. Sift and mix sugar and flour in large prep bowl and add to the mixing bowl with paddle.
On #1 speed, using the paddle, add the eggs, mix briefly then scrape the bowl and mix for 15 seconds more to blend then add lemon juice. Scrape down sides and bottom of mixing bowl to ensure sugar is incorporated and filling is evenly mixed. Mix on #2 for 2 minutes until froth forms and it thickens slightly. Carefully pour lemon filling over each base. Do not disturb the froth that will form on top of filling. Bake for 40 minutes on HIGH FAN then carefully rotate pans vertically as well as horizontally and bake for another 20-ish minutes on LOW FAN, when rotating pans be careful not to disturb the top crust that has formed, as it is still soft underneath. When done, the top should be firm, dry, and should have a rich, light golden color but not pale. cool OVERNIGHT UNREFRIGERATED.

name: MEATLOAF
directions:
GLAZE
   2 1/2  cups          ketchup
   6      Tablespoons   dry mustard
   1 1/2  cups          brown sugar
					
                        RED ONIONS
   8                    red onions
     3/4  cup           vegetable oil
					
                        ROSEMARY GRAVY
   6      cups          water
   1 1/2  Tbsp.         beef base
   4      ounces        softened roux

STEP ONE: Heat oven to 400 degrees.  Remove crust from bread, and place slices in the small robot coupe.  Transfer bread crumbs to a large mixing bowl.  Do not substitute dried bread crumbs in this step, as they will make your meat loaf rubbery. STEP TWO: Place carrot, celery, yellow onion, garlic, and parsley in the small robot coupe.  Process until vegetables have been minced, about 30 seconds, stopping to scrape down the sides of the bowl once or twice.  (Chopping vegetables this way saves time and ensures that vegetables will be small enough to cook through and not be crunchy).  Transfer vegetables to bowl with the bread crumbs.
STEP THREE: Add ketchup, dry mustard, pork, beef, eggs, salt, pepper, hot sauce, and rosemary.  Using your hands, knead the ingredients until thoroughly combined about 1 minute.  Be careful not to overknead; doing so will result in a heavy and dense loaf: The texture should be wet, but tight enough to hold a free-form shape.
STEP FOUR: Set a wire rack on a parchment line baking sheet.  Spray rack with vegalene.  Line the "loaf-size" plastic container with plastic wrap so that there is overhang.  Press meatloaf mixture into container.  Pat down firmly and even out top.  Turn container upside down onto rack; gently remove container and peel off plastic wrap.  Continue with remaining meatloaf mixture.
STEP FIVE: Using a pastry brush, generously brush the glaze over the loaf.  Place oil in a medium saucepan set over high heat.  When oil is smoking add red onion.  Cook, stirring occasionally, until onion is soft and golden in places.  Sprinkle onion over the meat loaf.
STEP SIX: Cover with foil and bake until the loaf registers 150 degrees.  Uncover and bake until the loaf registers 160 degrees.  Let meat loaf cool on rack.
Notes: 
After done baking, remove foil and cover with plastic wrap.  THIS IS A CRITICAL STEP.  *Foil will react if left on, creating a silvery waste!

name: WHITE CHILI (HEART SMART)
directions:
2 1/4  gallons       water
     3/4  pound         chicken base
					
   1 1/8  ounces        cumin
   1 1/8  ounces        chili powder
					
   2      pounds        yellow onion  fine dice
   2      ounces        fresh garlic  minced
   1      ounce         olive oil
   5      pounds        cooked turkey breat, torn into pieces
					
   1      ounce         salt
     1/4  ounce         ground black pepper
   1 1/8  ounces        cumin
   1 1/8  ounces        chili powder
   2 1/2  ounces        jalapeno peppers, canned  chopped

THE DAY BEFORE : Bring water to boil and add beans.  Cover and let set for 1 hour.  Refrigerate overnight.

DAY OF : Drain beans from night before.  Combine. Combine water, chicken base, cumin, and chili powder, and bring to boil.  Add soaked beans.  Simmer until tender.

Saute onions and garlic in olive oil until soft in braiser.  Add turkey, salt, pepper, chili powder and cumin to sauteed mixture.  Add beans, broth, and jalapenos to turkey mixture & 1 1/2 gallon water.  Simmer for 30 minutes.  Turn off heat.  Remove the beans and turkey from the liquid and place in a large, shallow container to cool.  Fill quart containers with 18 ounces bean and turkey mixture.  Top off with liquid.

name: WHITE CHOC. MACADAMIA COOKIES
directions:
In a separate large bowl, stir together flour, baking soda, and salt; set aside.  In mixing bowl with paddle attachment, beat margarine to soften.  Add both sugars and beat until light and fluffy.  Scrape sides and bottom of bowl often.  Add vanilla and eggs and continue beating until well mixed.  Add in flour mixture, white chips and macadamia nuts.  Mix on low speed until ingredients are evenly incorporated; do not overmix.  Bake in lower old oven at 300 degrees for about 13 to 14 minutes.

name: WINDY CITY PASTA
directions:
Preheat oven to 350

Cook pasta very al dente and drain, lightly toss with olive oil blend.

Toss all vegetables in olive oil blend and season with half of the SPG, crushed red pepper, and Italian seasoning. Spread onto sheet pans (do not crowd). Roast for 5 minutes or until veggies start to brown; allow to cool.

Combine remaining ingredients except for mozzerella, bake covered at 350 until heated through, top with mozzerella and return to oven to melt. Garnish with parsley.

name: WINDY CITY PASTA  2
directions:
Preheat oven to 350

Cook pasta very al dente and drain, lightly toss with olive oil blend.

Heat marinara in pan, when marinara is hot reduced temp to low and add heavy cream, when heated set aside until ready to combine.

Brown sausage before combing with other ingredients.
Toss all vegetables in olive oil blend and season with half of the SPG, crushed red pepper, and Italian seasoning. Spread onto sheet pans (do not crowd). Roast for 5 minutes or until veggies start to brown; allow to cool.

Combine all ingredients and creamy marinars sauce in a hotel pan, spread mozarella cubes througout and heat covered(spray foil) to 160 degrees. Appx 30 minutes.Garnish  with Parmesan cheese and chopped parsey.

name: WINDY CITY PASTA 2

ingredients.name: Parmesan cheese and Parsley for garnish

directions:
Preheat oven to 350

Cook pasta very al dente and drain, lightly toss with olive oil blend.

Heat sausage in pan, then add marinara and reduce by half.  Add heavy cream and reduce heat to hold.

Toss all vegetables in olive oil blend and season with half of the SPG, crushed red pepper, and Italian seasoning. Spread onto sheet pans (do not crowd). Roast for 5 minutes or until veggies start to brown; allow to cool.

Reheat Pasta in steamer and combine with all ingredients.  Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and garnish with parsley.

Using an immersion blender slowly add oil and blend until emulsified. LEMON VINIAGRETTE Combine everything except the salad oilin a large pot. Add the oil slowly and blend until emulsified. CHIMICHURRI RANCH Combine all ingredients in a large bowl and use the stick blender to incorporate. Slowly add the salad oil and use an immersion blender to mix, stop as soon as oil is mixed with the rest of ingredients or the dressing will be too thick. SCALLION CITRUS 15 cups scallions rough chop 5 cups lemon juice 2 tablespoons + 2 teaspoons SPG 13 1/3 cups canola blend 5 cups honey warmed 1 1/4 cups dijon 5 cups parsley rough chop combine honey, dijon,lemon juice and SPG and mix with stick blender. name: ZINGER WINGS
directions:
Combine 2 Tablespoons of flour with 3 Tablespoons of Cajun Seasonings in large mixing bowl.  Toss with amount of wings needed.   Arrange wings on a well-sprayed rack.  Bake at 400 degrees for 15 minutes; rotate pans then go an additional 10 minutes.  While wings are baking, gently warm Frank's hot sauce.  When wings are done, immediately toss with hot sauce.  Transfer to foil pan and garnish with green onions sliced on the hard bias.

FOR SAUCE:

Melt margarine over low heat, then stir in Red Hot Sauce.  Remove from heat.

Note:  A little sauce goes a long way.

name: ZUCCHINI BREAD
directions: Mix eggs, sugar, and oil.  Add all dry ingredients except zucchini and mix well.  Add shredded zuchinni and walnuts;  mix just until evenly incorporated.  OVERMIXING WILL TOUGHEN BREAD.  Scoop 1 1/2 pounds of batter into 15 loaf pans.  Bake at 300 degrees in new oven for about 1 hour (set timer for 50 minutes and check--bread should spring back to the touch and be a light golden color) bake for additional minutes if necessary.
